column3: BSB moves “chosen” to the end of the verse.
BSB adds “sanctified” and “to Jesus Christ” and renders “be multiplied” as “be yours in abundance.”
BSB starts a new sentence and renders “having begotten again” as “has given us new birth.”
BSB renders “proven genuineness” as “proven character” and “may be found” as “may result.”
BSB renders “what or what manner of time” as “the time and setting.”
BSB follows the critical text with “but you” (ὑμῖν); the Textus Receptus reads “but us.”
BSB renders “girded up the loins of your mind” as “prepare your minds for action.”
BSB renders “the time of your sojourn” as “your stay as foreigners.”
BSB follows the critical text without “through the Spirit,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB follows the critical text without “forever,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB follows the critical text with “its glory” (αὐτῆς); the Textus Receptus reads “the glory of man.”
